title: Fortin operators for DPG advection discretizations
summary: We construct Fortin operators for discontinuous Petrov-Galerkin (DPG) discretizations of the advection equation with a piecewise constant divergence-free advection vector $β$, on simplicial meshes of any spatial dimension $N$ and for any polynomial degree $k \ge 1$ of the trial space. A minimal test space is built on each element from facet and interior bubbles and later augmented. The Fortin operator is shown to be bounded, uniformly over shape-regular mesh families, in the natural $β$-weighted broken test graph norm built on $L_q$ for every $1 < q < \infty$, where $q$ is the exponent…
